name: Milngavie
description: Start of the West Highland Way. Train from Glasgow Queen St (20 min).

name: Drymen
description: Small village with a Co-op. Easy resupply before Loch Lomond.

name: Balmaha
description: Campsite on Loch Lomond shores. Midge hell in summer — bring a net.

name: Rowardennan
description: Forestry campsite. Basic facilities. Start of the rough loch-side path.

name: Inverarnan
description: The Drovers Inn — ancient, atmospheric, slightly chaotic pub hostel.

name: Crianlarich
description: SYHA hostel. Good resupply point. Village has a Co-op.

name: Tyndrum
description: By The Way campsite. Good facilities, hot showers. Real Food Cafe nearby.

name: Bridge of Orchy
description: Bridge of Orchy Hotel bunkhouse. Last shelter before Rannoch Moor.

name: Rannoch Moor (wild)
description: Wild camp on the moor. Utterly exposed, utterly beautiful. Check weather.

name: Kingshouse Hotel
description: Kingshouse bunkhouse. Gateway to the Devil's Staircase.

name: Kinlochleven
description: Blackwater Hostel. Laundry available. Local pub and Co-op.

name: Fort William
description: End of the WHW. Celebrations at the Grog & Gruel. Train back to Glasgow.
